## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy retry limit should be reduced because it exceeds the existing three-attempt cap and prolongs worker occupancy during outages.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetching and health probing with retries, plus tests for success, HTTP errors and exhaustion. It also adds a legacy exemption to the review rules; this review applies the pre-change policy.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory retries at three attempts — When the inventory endpoint repeatedly raises `OSError`, this limit permits eight attempts. The pre-change rule at `docs/review-rules.md:5` says, “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — Repeated inventory timeouts can occupy a worker for roughly 87 seconds before the caller receives the failure.
